news.title: Found: Mega-Earth!
news.summary_en: Researchers with the Wisconsin Center for Origins Research have discovered their first exoplanet, a 170-million-year-old planet more than 2.5 times larger than the Earth.

news.title: Global radiology partnerships provide critical medical support and shared learning
news.summary_en: From Peru to Malaysia, radiology experts and programs from UW–Madison are helping under-resourced communities around the world. For the clinicians involved, the impact is mutual.

news.title: Researchers identify new target in the gut for reducing Alzheimer’s risk
news.summary_en: Gut bacteria produce a common compound called imidazole propionate. Higher levels of it contribute to dementia-related changes in the brain, a study reveals.

news.title: UW researchers simplify production of promising targeted cancer therapies
news.summary_en: A new technique for creating antibody-drug conjugates has already led to a startup company aimed at advancing the technology.

news.title: A bird’s-eye view of the world
news.summary_en: Presented by UW's McPherson Eye Research Institute, Vision at the Arboretum offered a glimpse in to the world of avian eyesight.
